Canada's Largest Auction: Sunday Mega Liquidation Event!
Online Only Auction

Encore Auctions Inc

23 Buchanan Crt
London, ON N5Z 4P9

Map Opens in a new window

Date(s) 9/20/2026 - 10/4/2026

Starts closing at 12:00 PM Eastern Time. This is a timed online-only auction. Lots will begin closing sequentially at the posted time.

Welcome to this week’s Encore Auctions liquidation event, featuring a wide variety of customer-returned and overstock merchandise from major online retailers. This auction includes an exciting mix of electronics, home goods, small appliances, tools, décor, toys, health & beauty products, and more, all sourced from one of North America's largest e-commerce platforms. Items range from brand new in box to open box or gently used. Every lot includes photos and condition notes to help you bid confidently. Please review our T&C's as well as the FAQ on our website for important information before bidding! Don't miss your chance to score unbeatable deals on high-demand products!
